angra-dos-reis.base: Valeur vénale = valeur courante de marché, déterminée par l'administration ou valeur déclarée si supérieure (art. 46); avec financement: valeur d'achat si supérieure à l'évaluation bancaire (art. 47 XIV).
angra-dos-reis.note: Texte lu (consolidation officielle de la Secretaria de Finanças, avec renvois jusqu'en nov. 2025; son propre date non indiquée). Art. 49 caput imprimé 'A alíquota do imposto é de 2,% (dois inteiros décimos por cento)': coquille, '2%' retenu mais ambigu. Aucun renvoi à une modification de l'art. 49.

reduits.condition: Property financed by SFI (Anexo II as read; no mention of SFH)

armacao-dos-buzios.base: Value of goods transferred; determined by tax administration by appraisal (market/Cadastro) or declared value if higher (art. 42)
armacao-dos-buzios.loi: Lei Complementar nº 22, de 09/10/2009 (CTM), arts. 42 e 44 e Anexo II, version consolidated to LC 44 of 30/12/2017
armacao-dos-buzios.note: Texte lu (PDF officiel de la mairie), mais version 'atualizada em 01/02/2019 até LC 44/2017': lois postérieures non vérifiées (une loi de 2023 d'isenção d'ITBI est mentionnée par un extrait de recherche, non lue). L'ordre des cellules du tableau Anexo II extrait du PDF est à confirmer visuellement (1% SFI / 2,5% autres). Le formulaire ITBI de la mairie cite LC 001/98. Pas de mention marinha/laudêmio dans les passages lus.

belem.note: Taux 3 % lu seulement de façon indirecte (art. 8-A : « alíquota de 3% prevista no art. 8º »). Remise de 50 % si paiement anticipé dans 60 jours de l'acte (art. 8-A) ; régularisation des transmissions antérieures non enregistrées jusqu'au 31/07/2026 (art. 18-A, expirée), puis 3 % sans intérêts ni amende dès 01/08/2026. Texte de l'art. 8 de la Lei 8.792 et éventuel taux SFH/financé (Lei 10.251/2025 citée par presse) NON lus : aucun taux spécial retenu. Sefin inaccessible.

reduits.condition: No reduced SFH rate on the page ('Não há descontos'). Exemption: PMCMV borrower, family income up to 6 minimum wages, contract value up to R$ 225,556.19 and administration value up to R$ 270,643.13 (2026)
50% reduction when taxable base is up to R$ 254,292.79 (art. 1 Lei 10.692/2013; further conditions not read)

belo-horizonte.base: Value of the property at the time of transfer: administration appraisal from the cadastre, or declared value if higher (art. 5 par. 1, Lei 5.492/88); the declared transaction value in the DTIIV is presumed true until an administrative process sets it aside. Tema 1113 not named.
belo-horizonte.note: Official page read by me (curl, updated 2026-08-19). Rate 3% from 2014-05-01; the number of the law setting it is not on the page. Payment: before the deed if public instrument, before registration/inscription otherwise; guide valid 120 days. Other exemptions on the page: residential venal value up to R$ 74,595.39; PAR/FAR/FDS-type programs up to R$ 326,347.82 for income up to 6 minimum wages. fazenda.pbh.gov.br returned 403 (not bypassed).

boa-vista.base: Valeur vénale du bien ou droit transmis (art. 140), fixée selon le décret de valeurs vénales ; la valeur déclarée n'est retenue que si supérieure (art. 111 §2)
boa-vista.note: Art. 141 : 1,5 % sans réduction SFH dans le code. Lois modificatrices listées au SAPL (1.307/2010, 1.730/2016, LC 14/2021, LC 19/2021, Lei 2.256/2022, LC 22 et 23/2023) : aucune ne touche l'ITBI d'après OCR des textes. Anciennes lois 191/1989, 195/1989 (SFH 0,5 % financé / 2 % reste), 323/1993 (1,5 %) : l'art. 299 du code abroge « les dispositions contraires » sans citer la Lei 191 ; le sort du taux SFH 0,5 % est donc incertain (non retenu). Lei 2.226/2021 : autorise l'exonération de la 1re acquisition de logement neuf financé par familles à faible revenu (texte non lu). PDF scanné lu par OCR local.

reduits.condition: First transfer of a newly built property (first onerous transfer within 5 years counted from the year after the habite-se): 1%

brasilia.base: Valor venal of the property (administration appraisal; declared value prevails if higher per regulation art. 6 par. 2). Tema 1113 not mentioned.
brasilia.loi: Lei nº 3.830/2006 art. 9 (wording by Lei nº 7.635/2024, effects from 2025-01-01); Decreto nº 27.576/2006 arts. 5, 6, 9, 12
brasilia.note: All from SINJ-DF via WebFetch (tool summary); direct curl returned 403 (not bypassed). No SFH/MCMV/first-home rate found in the DF text. Payment (Decreto 27.576 art. 12): before the deed if drawn in the DF; before registration if private instrument; 30 days in other cases. A summary of Lei 3.830 mentions an art. 6 reworded by Lei 7.794/2025 banning a pre-set reference value: not verified.

reduits.condition: Transmissions under the SFH (Sistema Financeiro da Habitacao), on the financed portion only; no value ceiling seen in arts. 60-66

cabo-frio.base: Valor venal (current market value) at time of transfer (art. 60 and sole paragraph); authority may arbitrate the base (art. 64)
cabo-frio.loi: Lei Complementar nº 2/2002 (Código Tributário do Município), art. 65, I e II; art. 60
cabo-frio.note: Consolidated text on the Camara transparency portal, declared consolidated up to LC 073/2025; read via WebFetch (tool summary, upper-case text). Law dated 12/12/2002, published 30/12/2002. No marinha/foro/laudemio found in arts. 60-66 (only first 100000 chars were read by the tool). No first-home or MCMV specific rate seen. The fazenda.cabofrio.rj.gov.br ITBI page gives no rate.

reduits.condition: SFH transactions: effectively financed amount (excess over financing taxed at 2%)
Sales by the Public Authority of urban properties to low-income population in pre-set social allotment programs

campo-grande.base: Valor venal (base) per Sefaz page; ITBI-e FAQ: value of the property as appraised by the municipality; 2024 manual: appraised value or declared transaction value
campo-grande.loi: Lei nº 2.592/1989 (institutes ITBI; article of the rate not stated on the pages read); installments arts. 12 to 12-F
campo-grande.note: Texte lu on Sefaz page and ITBI-e FAQ (itbi.campogrande.ms.gov.br). No R$ cap on SFH rate found. Text of Lei 2.592/1989 itself not read. Payment by guide before the deed or within legal deadlines; up to 6 monthly installments (non-SFH detail not read). No Tema 1113 mention. Exemptions (EMHA/AGEHAB/FAR/PAR programs) are exemptions, not rates.

reduits.condition: SFH transfers: 0.5% on the amount actually financed, no value cap in the text; 2% on the remainder
PAR (Programa de Arrendamento Residencial) and Carta de Crédito Associativo acquisitions: 0.5%
MCMV / social housing programs, family income up to 6 minimum wages: exemption (0%)

cuiaba.base: Venal value from the Cadastro Imobiliário, if consistent with current market value (art. 226, LC 203/2009 wording); Tema 1113 STJ not cited
cuiaba.loi: Lei Complementar nº 43/1997 (Código Tributário) art. 228 (alíquotas), art. 226 (base), art. 229 (pagamento)
cuiaba.note: Rates confirmed on the 2026 Prefeitura page (Portal do Imposto) and in the CTM text 'atualizado 2013' (https://www.cuiaba.mt.gov.br/upload/arquivo/CTM%20ATUALIZADO%202013.pdf); the law text is the 2013 consolidation, later amendments not checked. Payment: until the deed date if made in Cuiabá (art. 229 I). Exemption page: https://portalfazenda.cuiaba.mt.gov.br/portalfazenda/PortalContribuinte/InformacoesITBI/InformacoesITBI

reduits.condition: Exemption for social-interest housing programmes of COHAB-CT (art. 10, 2017 text; later amendment by LC 148/2025 not read)

curitiba.base: Valeur vénale (valor venal) du bien ou droit transmis, = prix à vue en conditions normales de marché (art. 8 LC 108/2017 dans la rédaction de la LC 134/2022); aux enchères : prix d'adjudication actualisé IPCA.
curitiba.loi: LC 108/2017, art. 9, as amended by LC 134/2022
curitiba.note: Taux général 2,7 % lu dans le texte original de la LC 108/2017 (PDF mid.curitiba, OCR local). LC 134/2022 (lue) modifie art. 3, 8, 12 et révoque art. 13-14, sans toucher art. 9. LC 148/2025 (annoncée par des sources non officielles comme modifiant l'art. 11 : financement >= 10 ans; barèmes) NON LUE : site de la Prefeitura et de la Câmara en 403. Taux réduits actuels donc non établis. Statut 'lu' vaut pour le taux général seulement; possibilité qu'une loi postérieure à 2022 (autre que LC 148) modifie l'art. 9 non exclue.

reduits.condition: SFH, PAR and HIS transfers: 0.5% on the amount actually financed up to a cap (R$ 180,000.00 in the 2019 law, indexed each 1 January by IPCA); 2% on the rest

florianopolis.base: Venal value = value the property would reach in normal market conditions; declared by taxpayer (self-assessment, homologation by the Fazenda); Tema 1113 STJ not cited in the text read
florianopolis.loi: Lei Complementar nº 007/1997 art. 285, redação da Lei Complementar nº 683/2019 art. 6º (12/12/2019); base: art. 281 (LC 683/2019 art. 1º)
florianopolis.note: Text read from the Câmara Municipal site (curl). The cap is R$ 180,000 only in the 2019 text; the 2026 indexed value could not be read because pmf.sc.gov.br refused the connection (so plafond is null, not guessed). Later amendments to art. 285 not checked. Payment: 'na forma e prazo previsto em regulamento' (art. 286), regulation not read.

reduits.condition: SFH financing: 0.5% on amount actually financed up to the cap (2026 updated value)
Payment made before the deed or instrument that is the basis of the calculation: 2%

fortaleza.base: Highest of administration market value, declared value, or IPTU value; never below declared value. Tema 1113 not mentioned.
fortaleza.loi: not read (the Sefin page does not cite a law number; Código Tributário, LC nº 159/2013, not read)
fortaleza.note: Official Sefin FAQ page read by me (curl). No law/article number found: statute text not read, so the 4% is a Sefin statement, not a read article. The rate on the non-financed remainder of an SFH purchase is not stated explicitly on the page. Payment: 30 days from the notification of assessment; the 2% rate requires payment before the deed; installments up to 3 (no interest) or 6 (with Selic).

reduits.condition: Financed purchase of an own home, on the amount financed: 0% up to 600 UFFI, 0.5% to 1,400, 1% to 2,700, 2% above; price up to 4,000 UFFI

foz-do-iguacu.base: Valeur venale des biens ou droits transmis (art. 415, caput) ; valeur de l'instrument si conforme au marché (§1, LC 204/2013)
foz-do-iguacu.note: Valeur en R$ de l'UFFI non lue dans une source officielle (extraits de presse : 122,18 en 2026, non retenu). Aucune réduction temporaire trouvée dans le texte consolidé. Aucun amendement 2026 visible.

goiania.base: Not read: the official service page does not state the base; the tax is computed on an appraisal report issued by the Finance Secretariat
goiania.loi: Lei Complementar nº 344/2021 (Código Tributário Municipal), art. 203
goiania.note: Rate read (texte lu) on the Prefeitura process-description page; page undated, LC 344/2021 text itself not read; no SFH/MCMV/first-home rate found in official text read; payment within 180 days after the calculation; base de calcul and Tema 1113 not stated.

ilhabela.base: Value of the property at transfer, determined by tax administration by market-based appraisal or registry data, or declared value if higher (art. 128 par. 1)
ilhabela.loi: Lei nº 156/2002 (Código Tributário), arts. 128 e 130 (par. único do art. 130 revogado pela Lei 760/2009)
ilhabela.note: Texte lu sur le PDF de la Câmara, mais c'est un texte de Lei 156/2002 avec seulement la mention de la Lei 760/2009; modifications plus récentes non exclues (PL 68/2022 'altera dispositivos da Lei 156/2002', issue inconnue). Aucune page de la mairie avec le taux. Pas de mention marinha/laudêmio.

reduits.condition: Value actually financed under the SFH; 2% on the rest

ipojuca.base: Valeur vénale du bien au moment du fait générateur, établie par évaluation fiscale acceptée par le contribuable (art. 93). Pas d'alignement sur le Tema 1113 lu.
ipojuca.note: Texte lu (PDF officiel de la base de législation de la Prefeitura, accès invité). Consolidation datée 'Atualizado até 31/12/2000': modifications postérieures non confirmées. Lei 2.106/2022 (isenção/remissão ITBI, novos empreendimentos du complexe SUAPE) existe dans la base mais PDF scanné, non lu.

reduits.condition: Transfers under the SFH: rate on the effectively financed value; the remainder is taxed at 2%

itajai.base: Higher of the value agreed in the transaction and the venal value assigned (art. 52, redacao LC 307/2017); venal value method must be set by specific law, no random method (art. 52 par. 2)
itajai.loi: Lei Complementar nº 20/2002 (Código Tributário Municipal), art. 57, I e II (redação LC nº 161/2009, efeitos 01/01/2010); arts. 51-52
itajai.note: Texte lu (PDF extracted locally) from the prefeitura tax portal, an annotated consolidation whose latest listed amending law is LC 336/2018. Later amendments (2019-2026) not checked/found, so currency at 15/10/2026 is uncertain. Art. 52 'maior valor' rule may conflict with STJ Tema 1113 (not mentioned in the code text). A 2025 official gazette says ITBI is by homologation under LC 308/2017 (search snippet, not read). No marinha/laudemio mention in the code. No separate MCMV or first-home rate found.

reduits.condition: Exemption for the first transfer of popular housing (art. 209, I)

joao-pessoa.base: Valeur vénale du bien ou droit transmis (art. 205); évaluation officielle aux prix du marché si la valeur du contrat n'est pas supérieure (art. 207 §2).
joao-pessoa.note: Texte lu = PDF 'texto integral' du SAPL de la Câmara (scan, OCR local) : art. 206 'O ITBI é calculado à alíquota de 3,0% (três por cento)'. Pas de taux SFH/primo-accédant propre. Pas de version consolidée trouvée; lois modificatrices repérées au SAPL (ementas) : LC 86/2014 (lue : modifie art. 204 + remise 60 j), Leis 12.463/2013, 12.881/2014, 14.313/2021, 14.482/2022 (remise 30 % jusqu'au 31/03/2022), 15.048/2023 (30 % 16/10/2023...) : toutes des remises temporaires, expirées. Aucune loi trouvée qui change l'art. 205/206. Incertitude : les lois de 2022-2026 citent 'art. 208, §3º, II', absent du texte 2008 lu, donc il existe une modification de l'art. 208 non lue.

reduits.condition: Residential property financed for at least 5 years (any guarantee), property venal fraction up to 1,500 UPM: rate applies to the financed amount
Same financing, venal fraction above 1,500 UPM: 2% on the financed amount; tax = sum of each rate on its slice of value

joinville.base: Valor venal = market value in normal conditions at transfer (art. 6 as amended by LC 672/2023); declared value arbitrated if it differs, with adversarial defense; for bank-financed purchases the value stated in the financing contract is taken as venal value (art. 6 par. 5)
joinville.loi: Lei Complementar nº 400/2013, art. 8 caput e §§ 1º-2º; art. 6 (redação da LC nº 672/2023, de 20/12/2023, em vigor 120 dias após publicação)
joinville.note: Texte lu: art. 8 from Jornal do Municipio no 1.020 of 20/12/2013 (original LC 400); 0.5%/2% tiers also in prefeitura manual v01.24 (joinville.sc.gov.br/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/Manual-para-Emissao-Automatica-do-ITBI-Financiamento-Imobiliario.pdf). Art. 6 text read in LC 672/2023 (wwwold.joinville.sc.gov.br/public/portaladm/pdf/jornal/984b9854d675bf0cc576d810a725c4df.pdf). No consolidated current text of art. 8 found: later amendment of art. 8 not excluded (LC 672 amends arts 3, 6, 9, 11, 14 only). UPM value in R$ not read, so the 1,500 UPM ceiling is not converted. Tema 1113 STJ not cited in the law text. No marinha mention. Prefeitura page: installment in 12 parts (LC 672/2023). camara.joinville.br blocked by bot check, not bypassed.

reduits.condition: SFH-financed purchase, financed value up to 34,450 UFIR (rate applied to the financed amount)
SFH-financed purchase, financed value above 34,451 UFIR (tier II; text as written)
SFH-financed purchase, financed value above 68,900 UFIR
Non-financed part of an SFH purchase
Temporary reduction (Lei 14.004/2025 art. 1, per Decree in JO 5758): deeds signed until 2026-12-31; scope per decree = individuals acquiring from COHAB-LD/COHABAN/COHAPAR housing programs

londrina.base: Valor venal declared by taxpayer or assessed by Fisco, determined at date of payment (art. 183)
londrina.loi: Lei nº 7.303/1997 (Código Tributário) arts. 183 and 185, wording of Lei 12.576/2017 for art. 183; Lei 14.004/2025 art. 1-2 (temporary COHAB scheme, text not read, only the regulating decree)
londrina.note: Texte lu (PDF extrait localement), mais copie du Code imprimée le 17/10/2023 : amendements postérieurs non vérifiés. UFIR en R$ non convertie (aucun chiffre de mémoire). Décret du JO nº 5758 du 27/04/2026 (https://portal.londrina.pr.gov.br/images/stories/jornalOficial/Jornal-5758-Assinado.pdf) lu : réduction temporaire de 0,5 % (escrituras jusqu'au 31/12/2026) / 1,0 % (2027), réservée aux personnes physiques acquéreurs d'immeubles issus de contrats avec COHAB-LD/COHABAN/COHAPAR ; texte de la Lei 14.004 non lu. Pages Carta de Serviços et valor de referência: erreur de certificat, non lues. Pas de mention de terrenos de marinha ; art. 179-180 visent la propriété ou le domaine útil (aforamento) sans plus.

reduits.condition: SFH transfers: 1% on the financed portion, 2% on the rest (no value cap in the text)
SFH transfer using FGTS: 1% on the value

macapa.base: Higher of the value agreed in the transaction and the venal value from the Planta Genérica de Valores; Tema 1113 STJ not cited
macapa.loi: Lei Complementar nº 144/2021-PMM (30/12/2021) art. 208 (alíquotas), art. 207 (base), art. 209 (pagamento)
macapa.note: Consolidated 'com alterações' PDF (published 2023) read; amendments after 2023 not checked. Payment: until the 20th day after registration at the Registro de Imóveis (art. 209). Base rule (higher of deal value and PGV) is in tension with Tema 1113 STJ, which the text does not mention.

reduits.condition: SFH transactions: financed part
Other transfers (not SFH) when ITBI is paid after 30 days from the deed: 3%

maceio.base: Higher of the transaction value or the valor venal updated by the municipality (art. 33)
maceio.loi: Lei nº 4.486/1996 (Código Tributário), arts. 33 and 34, as amended by Leis 5.677/2008, 5.837/2009 and 5.869/2009
maceio.note: Texte lu: consolidation on the Prefeitura ITBI-e portal, valid only up to the 2009 amendments; later changes (2010-2026) not verified. 2% applies if paid up to the deed or within 30 days of it (art. 34 II-III), else 3%. 2021 Prefeitura news confirms the 30-day mechanism. PAR/FAR faixa 1 first-home exemption (Lei 7.478/2023) is an exemption, not a rate. Base: Portaria 2021 uses the financing appraisal for SFH (news 2021-06-21).

mata-de-sao-joao.base: Transmissions onéreuses en général: valeur vénale des biens ou droits transmis, si l'autorité fiscale est d'accord (art. 106 I); l'autorité peut utiliser les prix courants du marché (art. 107).
mata-de-sao-joao.loi: LC 006/2022 (Tax Code; the tax is called ITIV), arts. 106-108
mata-de-sao-joao.note: Texte lu (PDF Câmara, SAPL). Aucun taux SFH/MCMV. Art. 111 (LC 007/2022): exonération pour agents publics municipaux >2 ans de service, premier logement. Le SAPL ne liste aucune loi 2025-2026; modifications récentes non exclues.

reduits.condition: Financed portion under SFH (popular housing); unfinanced portion 2%

niteroi.base: Not confirmed in a quoted sentence; page states the construction value is not included in the base in certain cases (art. 54 par. 1 Lei 2.678/09); the search summary of the city site said higher of venal value and transaction value, not verified on the fetched page
niteroi.loi: Código Tributário de Niterói, Livro II (Lei 2.678/2009), art. 54 par. 1 e art. 51 (citados pela page, numéros à confirmer)
niteroi.note: Résumé outil (WebFetch) de la page officielle de la Fazenda; texte de loi non lu; plafond de valeur du bien éventuel non vu; condition 'habitação popular' mentionnée, définition non lue. Pas de mention marinha/laudêmio.

reduits.condition: SFH transfers where the financing is below 85,000 UFIP (about R$ 410,550 at UFIP 2026 = R$ 4.83, computed): 0.5% on the amount actually financed

palmas.base: Highest of: fiscal appraisal, price list, value in the contract, Planta de Valores Genéricos (rural: ITR value + improvements); Tema 1113 STJ not cited
palmas.loi: Lei Complementar nº 285/2013 (31/10/2013) art. 33 I e III (alíquotas), arts. 31-32 (base), art. 36 (pagamento)
palmas.note: Consolidated text of 20/11/2023 read (urban 2%, rural 3%). UFIP 2026 = R$ 4.83 read in a Prefeitura news item (https://www.palmas.to.gov.br/core/noticias/prefeito-eduardo-siqueira-campos-assina-decreto-que-regulamenta-a-concessao-dos-beneficios-eventuais/); the cap in reais is my multiplication 85,000 x 4.83 = 410,550, not a published figure. The law does not say what applies when the financing reaches 85,000 UFIP (presumably the general 2%). Amendments after 2023 not checked. Payment: before the act, lump sum or up to 6 instalments (art. 36).

reduits.condition: Financed portion under SFH, only if total property value does not exceed R$ 700,000; remainder taxed at 2%

paraty.base: Market value of goods or rights transferred, set by the Comissão de Avaliação de Imóveis (art. 317)
paraty.loi: Lei Complementar nº 107/2022 (Código Tributário), arts. 317 e 318 (Diário Oficial nº 1171, 30/09/2022; vigência 90 jours après publication, art. 486)
paraty.note: Texte lu (PDF officiel, Diário Oficial 30/09/2022). Modifications postérieures à 2022 non vérifiées (la page de consolidation de la transparence liste d'autres lois). Pas de mention marinha/laudêmio dans le texte lu.

reduits.condition: Financed part of residential real-estate loans (min. term 5 years, incl. consortia) and buyer's FGTS funds; excess above cap taxed at 3%

porto-alegre.base: Valor venal (market value) at the time of the municipal fiscal estimate; carta de serviços says higher of valor venal and transaction value
porto-alegre.loi: Lei Complementar nº 197/1989, art. 16 (rates); IN RM 001/2026 (base)
porto-alegre.note: Cap 68,000 UFM; plafond in R$ is my computation 68,000 x R$ 6.0411 (UFM 2026 per prefeitura.poa.br/smf/unidade-financeira-municipal-ufm) = R$ 410,794.80. Carta updated 2026-04-16. The consolidated current text of LC 197 (with amendments) was not read; only the original 1989 art. 16. Conflict: carta says higher of valor venal/transaction; IN RM 001/2026 says valor venal at fiscal estimate. No Tema 1113 mention.

porto-seguro.note: The rate article read is internally contradictory (« 6,00 % (três por cento) »): not computed until the text in force is read.

porto-velho.base: Highest of: market appraisal, cadastral/venal value, declared transaction value, price list; never below the venal value (Tema 1113 STJ not cited)
porto-velho.loi: Lei Complementar nº 878/2021 (17/12/2021) art. 234 (alíquota), art. 233 (base), art. 240 (pagamento)
porto-velho.note: Original 2021 law text read; 'alíquota única 2%' also confirmed on the Prefeitura portal (https://servicos.portovelho.ro.gov.br/semec/info-itbi; news of 02/09/2025). No SFH/MCMV rate in the law (art. 233 §6 IV only sets venal value as base for SFH). Exemption only for first deed in municipal land regularization (art. 241). Amendments after 2021 (e.g. LC 926/2022, 944/2023) not read for art. 234. Payment: before registration (art. 240).

reduits.condition: SFH: 1% on the financed amount up to R$ 500,000 indexed (R$ 1,036,600.71 for 2026 per the Code); 3% on the excess
Early payment (request filed within 180 days of habite-se / signing of instrument; for SFH, from the financing contract signing): 1.8% instead of 3% (or on the SFH excess)

recife.base: Valor venal = cash value under normal market conditions; buyer declares it and the city may appraise (art. 51 par. 3; par. 4). Tema 1113 not mentioned.
recife.loi: Lei nº 15.563/1991 (Código Tributário Municipal) arts. 51, 52, 55; text updated to Lei nº 19.490 of 2026-03-09
recife.note: Code PDF (text extracted by me, checked 2026-03-28 per its cover) and FAQ page read. Payment art. 55: up to the date of the public deed, or of the transcription of the private instrument. FAQ gives R$ 1,036,600.33 for the SFH cap versus R$ 1,036,600.71 in the Code: Code figure retained. A temporary 2025 reduction (Lei 19.452/2025) reported by press is not in the Code text read.

reduits.condition: SFH financing, property value up to R$ 65,000: financed part

ribeirao-preto.base: market (commercialization) value less 10% per LC 2.496/2011 art. 2; municipal FAQ says minimum base = IPTU value
ribeirao-preto.loi: Lei Complementar nº 2.496 de 21/12/2011 (publ. 22/12/2011) arts. 2 to 4, new arts. 12 and 17 of Lei nº 5.430/1989
ribeirao-preto.note: All via WebFetch (resume outil). FAQ https://www.ribeiraopreto.sp.gov.br/portal/fazenda/perguntas-frequentes says 'A alíquota é 2%.' and 'A base de cálculo mínima é o valor relativo ao IPTU.' Later amendments (LC 2.666/2014 keeps 10% discount for properties up to 10,000 UFESP and defines value as commercialization value) not fully reconciled with the 10% discount rule; Lei 5.430/1989 consolidated text not found on the official site. Whether the R$ 65,000 limit is still current is not confirmed. No marinha mention.

reduits.condition: SFH transfers: 0.5% on the amount actually financed, no value cap in the text; 2% on the rest

rio-branco.base: Venal value; the value in the deed is used, but the venal value (PGV) or market price prevails if the deed value is lower; Tema 1113 STJ not cited
rio-branco.loi: Lei nº 1.508/2003 (08/12/2003, Código Tributário Municipal) art. 39 (alíquotas), arts. 37-38 (base), art. 40 (pagamento)
rio-branco.note: Law text read from the Controladoria portal (version posted in 2013); the 0.5%/2% rates are confirmed by the current state-portal service page (https://homologacao.ac.gov.br/acgovbr/servico/laudo-de-itbi-imovel-rural-compra-e-venda-pessoa-fisica-1a-via). Amending laws listed on the portal (LC 18/2015, 28/2017, 277/2023, etc.) read: none changes the ITBI articles; list may be incomplete. PMCMV exemption exists in LC 05/2014 and LC 19/2017 (not analysed). Payment: before the transfer act (art. 40).

reduits.condition: Popular property (residential, private built area up to 39.56 m2, updated venal value up to R$ 44,996.73 per Decreto 24.058/2013 text): 1%

salvador.base: Valor venal = cash value under normal market conditions (art. 117 as worded by Lei 9.767/2023); declared value contested only after an administrative process. Tema 1113 not mentioned. Tax is called ITIV in Salvador.
salvador.loi: Lei nº 7.186/2006 (Código Tributário e de Rendas) arts. 116-118, 122; Decreto nº 24.058/2013 art. 8
salvador.note: Both PDFs read by me (text extracted). Art. 118: 1% popular property per regulation, 3% other. Payment art. 122: in advance, up to the date of the deed. No SFH-linked rate. The R$ 44,996.73 cap is the 2013 text of the decree; no later update seen. The consolidated Code may not include amendments after 2024.

reduits.condition: SFH: on the financed part up to 25,700 FMP (2% above)

santo-andre.base: Valeur vénale (valor pelo qual o bem seria négocié à vista, conditions normales de marché); la valeur de l'acte est utilisée si elle correspond à la valeur vénale, sinon prévaut le valor venal de référência (arts. 30-31)
santo-andre.note: Texte lu (HTML téléchargé par curl) sur le système de législation de la Câmara de Santo André (site officiel; port 9000 en http). Le site avertit que seul le Diário Oficial produit des effets légaux. Valeur en R$ du FMP (fixée par acte de la Fazenda, art. FMP) non lue. Aucune réduction temporaire repérée dans le texte. Decreto 18.564/2026 (règlement ITBI) non lu.

reduits.condition: SFH financing: financed part
Housing cooperatives for popular housing and COHABs

santos.base: real value or price of the asset, floor = IPTU base value of the year
santos.loi: Lei nº 634 de 28/12/1989, art. 5º I-III e art. 7º (texto consolidado até 31/12/2025)
santos.note: Text read (PDF downloaded and extracted). No MCMV/first-home specific rate and no cap on SFH financed value in the text. No marinha/laudemio mention. Original date of rates is 1989; no later amendment to art. 5 is shown in the consolidated text.

reduits.condition: Financed portion under SFH
Property up to R$ 128,024.29 when buyers own no other property

sao-jose-dos-campos.base: Value declared by taxpayer = cash price in normal market conditions; municipality may arbitrate if declared value differs from market value (Art. 6 and 7); no reference-value floor in the law text
sao-jose-dos-campos.loi: Lei Complementar nº 696, de 23/09/2025, arts. 6, 7 e 9 (vigência 01/01/2026, art. 31)
sao-jose-dos-campos.note: Texte lu (PDF officiel, extraction texte locale). La page ITBI de la mairie (sjc.sp.gov.br/.../iptu-2026/itbi/, résumé outil) cite encore la LC 383/2009 et parle de 'maior valor entre pago e valor de référence PGV': contradiction avec la LC 696/2025 (en vigueur 01/01/2026, révoque les dispositions contraires). Page non mise à jour ou autre lecture : à confirmer. Pas de mention marinha/laudêmio.

reduits.condition: SFH/PAR/HIS (contracts from 2022-02-25): 0.5% on financed amount up to the cap; 3% on the rest; property value must be at or below the cap, above it 3% on the whole base

sao-paulo.base: Greater of transaction value and reference market value (valor venal de referência); statute art. 7 says valor venal = cash value under normal market conditions. Tema 1113 STJ not mentioned on the pages read.
sao-paulo.loi: Lei nº 11.154/1991 arts. 7 and 10 (art. 10 as worded by Lei nº 17.719/2021, caps updated annually); Decreto nº 55.196/2014
sao-paulo.note: Rate 3% and 2026 caps from the Fazenda page via WebFetch (tool summary, page dated 2026-01-13). Statute text read directly (legislacao.prefeitura.sp.gov.br, consolidated with history): art. 10 II = 3%; base R$100,000 / R$600,000 in the law, indexed per art. 10 par. 2. Payment: art. 12, before the deed if public instrument, within 10 days of its date if private instrument. The rule 'greater of' is only from the tool summary of the page.

reduits.condition: Homes of low-income housing programmes, or request filed within 180 days of the contract (art. 88)

teresina.base: Valeur vénale = valeur de marché actuelle fixée par l'Administration (évaluation, CIF/IPTU ou valeur déclarée), la plus élevée prévalant, jamais inférieure à la valeur vénale IPTU (arts 85-86)
teresina.note: Pas de taux réduit SFH/part financée dans le code. PDF scanné lu par OCR local (macOS Vision), numérotation des articles perturbée par l'OCR. Lois modificatrices consultées dans l'acervo (5093/2017, 5839/2022, 5950/2023, 5980/2023, 6049/2023, 6104/2024, 6208/2025, 6313/2025) : aucune ne touche l'art. 88 d'après les extraits lus ; l'acervo peut être incomplet. Décret 28.864/2026 (règlement) non lu.

tibau-do-sul.base: Valeur de marché du bien ou droit au moment de la transmission ; l'impôt ne peut être inférieur à la valeur retenue pour l'IPTU (arts 175-176)
tibau-do-sul.note: Réponse au contrôle : le 3 % est confirmé mais le SFH 1 % sur le financé de la LC 002/2001 n'apparaît plus dans le code de 2002 (art. 179 = 3 % unique ; art. 181 = exonération 1re habitation populaire <=70 m2 sur terrain <=150 m2 pour acquéreur à faible revenu sans autre bien dans la commune). LC 005 art. 270 abroge les dispositions contraires (clause générale). Texte OCR de la LC 005 (couche texte du PDF officiel de la Câmara) ; LC 009/2024 lue (couche texte, diffusion DOM FEMURN) : modifie arts 96, 97, 117, 222, 224, 225 (IPTU/taxes), crée art. 160-A, pas d'article ITIV. Lois ordinaires postérieures non épuisées.

reduits.condition: SFH: on the value actually financed (2% on the rest)

ubatuba.base: Valeur venale (Planta Genérica de Valores, Lei 1.011/89 anexos I-II) ou valeur déclarée si supérieure; jamais inférieure à la valeur IPTU de l'exercice (art. 7 I, art. 8). PGV réévaluée de 0,92 % pour 2026 (Decreto 8.949/2025)
ubatuba.note: Texte lu (fichier lié depuis https://www.camaraubatuba.sp.gov.br/proposicoes/Leis-Ordinarias/2009/1/0/13603). La fiche de la Câmara ne liste aucune loi modificatrice de la 3.289/2009 (seul lien : révocation partielle de la 1.011/89), mais absence d'amendement non prouvée. Pas de plafond en R$ pour le SFH.

reduits.condition: Property acquired through a housing cooperative: 1%

vitoria.base: Value of the property set by the Prefeitura (land area, construction, location, etc.); Tema 1113 STJ not cited
vitoria.loi: Lei nº 3.571/1989 art. 16 I (cooperativa) e Decreto nº 12.882/2006, as cited by the Prefeitura; law text itself not read

Payment: full ITBI must be paid before registration of the title at the Registro de Imóveis.

No SFH/first-home reduction appears in the table or in Lei 14.756/2023.

Escritura = item 1 i 'outras escrituras com conteudo financeiro' incl. traslado; ceiling R$ 5,482.90 (obs. 6 d). Registro = item 1 'Registro, compreendidas as referencias e o arquivamento'. Same 21 bands and amounts for both. Base = higher of declared price and ITBI value. 50% reduction for first residential acquisition financed by SFH; PMCMV registro: -75% (FAR/FDS) or -50% (FGTS). Electronic selo R$ 0.15/unit (Decreto 1075 art. 3) bought by the cartorio.
